Attached: 3 images

I built Pocket SSH Terminal, an Android SSH client for your own servers. Keys stay on the phone behind your fingerprint, no account, no tracking, and it works great with Tailscale. Free for a week.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dk.pocketssh&referrer=utm_source%3Dmastodon
